mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, type, title, content, related_type, related_id, read_flag, send_status, retry_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, #{readFlag}, #{sendStatus}, #{retryCount})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_flag = 0
